The '''Heavy Steel Cache''' is a special time-limited crate. It contains some of the units released in previous crates, but only 3-star and better units.

Cost: 90 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Ares]] x1 (originally released in [[Accelerator Crate]])
* [[Phalanx]] x1 (originally released in [[Accelerator Crate]])
* [[Nostromos]] x1 (originally released in [[Overdrive Crate]])
* [[Stingray]] x2 (originally released in [[Laser Crate]])
* [[Nighthawk]] x2 (originally released in [[Overdrive Crate]])
* [[Fireball]] x2 (originally released in [[Accelerator Crate]])
